conceptual assets.information: The unit stores byte-combined memory words written by bus requests and returns selected words for loads; correct data-memory operation depends on these contents.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The stored contents may include private or security-relevant data and are exposed through rdata at lines 75-78 and 106-109 and bus_rsp_o.data at line 129. The memory arrays accept bus_req_i.data at lines 63-72 and 92-101, so an unauthorized write can modify stored contents. The rden-controlled assignment at line 129 can withhold the stored word by returning zero, with rden loaded at line 124.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could read returned memory words, overwrite selected bytes with a bus write, or suppress a required read response.

conceptual assets.information: This is the address-derived selection of which memory word a read or write uses; correct load and store behavior depends on selecting the intended word.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The address slice is assigned to addr at line 113, and addr indexes both memory writes at lines 63-72 and 92-101 and reads at lines 75-78 and 106-109, so changing it can redirect an access to a different word.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter the access address so a write corrupts an unintended memory word or a read returns data from an unintended location.

conceptual assets.information: The registered read-enable decision determines whether selected memory data is returned or suppressed on the response; it has no entry or exit port because request fields only decide it and it only gates bus_rsp_o.data.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: rden is a control decision loaded from bus request fields at line 124 and controls the returned data at line 129, so unauthorized alteration can make a response contain the wrong value. When rden is cleared or remains inactive, line 129 returns zero instead of memory data, allowing a required read result to be withheld.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could force the read-release decision inactive or active at the wrong time to suppress valid reads or expose data on an unintended response.

considered, not kept.concept: RAM byte arrays and rdata staging

considered, not kept.reason: bus_req_i.stb, rw and ben describe the access and byte enables rather than forming separate information pieces under the Access command fields rule (lines 61-72, 90-101 and 124-125).

considered, not kept.concept: Bus response acknowledge and error status
considered, not kept.reason: The acknowledge repeats the request strobe and the error field is tied to a constant, so the response handshake and status do not form independent information pieces (lines 125 and 130).
clk_i and rstn_i only time or reset internal elements and are excluded as conceptual assets by the clock and reset rule (lines 26-27, 60, 120 and 123).
DMEM_SIZE, alt_style_c and addr_hi_c are fixed build-time values that no runtime element can change or withhold (lines 23, 36, 39, 57-58 and 84-86).
